headline: Every pack of pies checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
visitLine: Call and visit to Coburg North
heroLede: As wholesale grows, every pack that leaves Coburg North needs the right label and date. Here's what a camera check could look like on your packing line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every pack is closed properly, flaps down and square. An open pack means damaged pies and a complaint from the customer.
labelLede: A beef pack and a beef and cheese pack look much the same at line speed, and one of them carries milk. The camera checks every pack carries the right label for the pies inside, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every pack. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Pastry offcuts, glove pieces and loose parts can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a crate.

vocab.alert: Four open flaps in fifteen minutes. Check the closer.
